value.text:
The project does not use GORM or TableName methods. Table mappings must be found through direct struct definitions.

The custom store layer uses raw SQL. `store.User` in `store/user.go` maps to the `user` table via `store/db/sqlite/user.go` and `store/db/postgres/user.go`. `store.Attachment` in `store/attachment.go` maps to the `attachment` table via `store/db/sqlite/attachment.go`. `store.Reaction` in `store/reaction.go` maps to the `reaction` table via `store/db/sqlite/reaction.go`.

-- system_setting
CREATE TABLE system_setting (
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  value TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  UNIQUE(name)
);

-- user
CREATE TABLE user (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  created_ts BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now')),
  updated_ts BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now')),
  row_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (row_status IN ('NORMAL', 'ARCHIVED')) DEFAULT 'NORMAL',
  username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USER',
  email TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  nickname TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  avatar_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);

-- user_setting
CREATE TABLE user_setting (
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  key TEXT NOT NULL,
  value TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(user_id, key)
);

value.text:
No ORM is used. Table mappings are handled by raw SQL in store/db/* drivers using store package structs.

`user` maps to `store.User` in `store/user.go`.
`attachment` maps to `store.Attachment` in `store/attachment.go`.
`reaction` maps to `store.Reaction` in `store/reaction.go`.
These struct names appear in the raw SQL driver files.

No TableName methods exist. Manual SQL mapping in store/db/sqlite and store/db/postgres links each struct to its table.

This repo has **no GORM/ORM `TableName` methods**. Database tables are mapped via **`store` package structs** and **raw SQL** in `store/db/sqlite/` and `store/db/postgres/`.

| Table | Struct | Go file | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`user`** | **`User`** | `store/user.go` | `CreateUser` in `store/db/sqlite/user.go` runs `INSERT INTO user (...)` and scans into `*store.User`; schema in `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` (`CREATE TABLE user`). |
| **`attachment`** | **`Attachment`** | `store/attachment.go` | `CreateAttachment` in `store/db/sqlite/attachment.go` runs `INSERT INTO attachment (...)` and scans into `*store.Attachment`; schema in `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` (`CREATE TABLE attachment`). |
| **`reaction`** | **`Reaction`** | `store/reaction.go` | `UpsertReaction` in `store/db/sqlite/reaction.go` runs `INSERT INTO reaction (...)` and scans into `*store.Reaction`; schema in `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` (`CREATE TABLE reaction`). |

**Note:** There are also protobuf API types named `User`, `Attachment`, and `Reaction` under `proto/gen/api/v1/` (e.g. `user_service.pb.go`, `attachment_service.pb.go`, `memo_service.pb.go`). Those are **API messages**, not database row models. The table-backed structs are the three in `store/` above.
